spec.claim_summary: Buy Nikkei 225 components on a daily close crossing above the 80-day plus-1-sigma upper band and sell on a close crossing below the 80-day middle band.
assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim tests all Nikkei 225 components individually; the schema tests one symbol history at a time, so NIKKEI225 is used as the closest single-symbol proxy and the per-stock universe result cannot be replicated.
Upper +1-sigma line interpreted as Bollinger upper band with period 80 and 1.0 standard deviations.
Middle band interpreted as 80-period simple moving average, the standard Bollinger middle band.
Entry and exit are evaluated on bar closes with fills at the next bar open, matching buy/sell at the next day's open per engine convention.
No stop-loss, take-profit, trailing stop or max hold was stated, so exit relies solely on the middle-band cross.
Test Period cited is stored in claimed.period_start/end only; the engine tests all available history.

evidence.quote: Buy at the next day’s open using a market order
Price crosses above the +1σ line from below
If the price crosses below the middle band, sell at the next day’s open using a market order

audit_majors: assets: Claim targets all Nikkei 225 components tested individually; spec tests single symbol NIKKEI225 index as proxy. Index history is not the per-stock component universe and can change the verdict.
